about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Josh Gottheimer

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING ECONOMIC AND ACADEMIC FREEDOM
statements.title: PROTECTING ECONOMIC AND ACADEMIC FREEDOM
sentences: Yet, that is what boycott, divest, and sanction seeks to do, which targets one country and one religion: Israel and Judaism.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of my bill with Ms. Virginia Foxx of North Carolina, the Protect Economic and Academic Freedom Act.
I urge my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to support this bipartisan bill. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ANTHONY "TONY" J. GALLOPO VA CLINIC
statements.title: ANTHONY "TONY" J. GALLOPO VA CLINIC
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of my bill, H.R. 6007.
Mr. Speaker, I urge the House to pass this legislation, and I am so grateful for the bipartisan support.
I also urge the Senate--I know Senator Cory Booker has taken the lead on this--to take this up quickly and honor our great hero, Tony Gallopo.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE THE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES AGAINST THE ISLAMIC REPUBL
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE THE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES AGAINST THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN
sentences: It has been 74 days since the start of the conflict in Iran, and Congress still hasn't been formally briefed on the objectives, our progress, or what success looks like.

The War Powers Act of 1973 only affirms that responsibility, clearly laying out, in furtherance of the Constitution, that the President has 60 days after formally informing the Congress to either come to Congress for declaration of war or an Authorization For Use of Military Force.
I believe the Iranian regime must be crushed.
The ayatollah has killed tens of thousands of their own citizens in Iran, brutally so, just for seeking freedom.
They are an enemy of the United States of America and work closely with our other adversaries, including Russia, North Korea, and China.
Unlike some of my colleagues who oppose taking on this regime, I believe--no, I actually know, that the world is a safer and more secure place if the Iranian regime were destroyed.
I support the administration crushing the Iranian regime.
That is why we, ultimately, had the War Powers Act of 1973, so the President couldn't go it alone.
Under the War Powers Act, he is prohibited from keeping armed forces engaged in a conflict for more than 60 days without congressional approval.

But this administration has not given real briefings on the Iran conflict to the Intelligence Committee or the Foreign Affairs Committee or the Armed Services Committee, formal briefings related to this conflict.
Yesterday alone, I learned from The New York Times that Iran maintained 70 percent of its pre-war missile stockpile despite our military actions.
I learned or read, at least, in The New York Times that Iran has restored operational access to 30 of 33 missile sites it maintains along the Strait of Hormuz.

After strikes against Iranian- backed militia groups in Iraq and Syria in 2021, the Biden administration notified Congress and sent a formal letter explaining their legal justifications under an existing Congressional authority.

Make no mistake, my resolution explicitly grants us the ability to maintain a presence in the region, to respond to any Iranian aggression that places Americans or our allies in danger, and to safely remove our troops.
This vote isn't whether or not we should crush the Iranian regime.
Again, as I said, I believe the Iranian regime should be crushed.
By the way, I completely agree with your outline of the threats that Iran poses, and I want to be very clear about that.
I would ask Chairman Meeks the same question, but that has been, just so you understand, the real frustration, because I am with you that we should crush Iran.
I had hoped the administration would have changed their course after I introduced it and properly briefed the Congress and the country.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DENOUNCING THE HORRORS OF SOCIALISM
statements.title: DENOUNCING THE HORRORS OF SOCIALISM
sentences: Democrats just had a huge win across the country because we focused on what hardworking families care about: lowering food and healthcare prices, cutting childcare costs, and lowering utility bills.
Tax-raising, job-killing policies like defunding the police, shuttering prisons, massive unfunded spending increases, and even government-run grocery stores.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of this bill.
I urge all Republicans to work with us on those pressing issues.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IMPROVING ACCESS TO SMALL BUSINESS INFORMATION ACT
statements.title: IMPROVING ACCESS TO SMALL BUSINESS INFORMATION ACT
sentences: I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on this important bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GREENLIGHTING GROWTH ACT
statements.title: GREENLIGHTING GROWTH ACT
sentences: This bill will eliminate this regulatory hurdle by ensuring EGCs only need to provide 2 years, not 3, of audited financials across the board, whether for an IPO, an acquisition, or a follow-on offering.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL SENIOR INVESTOR INITIATIVE ACT OF 2025
statements.title: NATIONAL SENIOR INVESTOR INITIATIVE ACT OF 2025
sentences: Every 2 years the task force will also submit a report to Congress outlining trends and innovations, including robocalls and voice spoofing and all the developments in artificial intelligence that are impacting seniors to help us stay ahead of changes in financial scams.
With new technologies like artificial intelligence, these scams are becoming and will continue to be ever more prevalent in the years ahead.
Mr. Speaker, in this Congress, as in previous Congresses, I introduced the Senior Security Act to protect vulnerable seniors from fraudsters who seek to take financial advantage of them.
Mr. Speaker, I urge all my colleague to support this bill which will allow the Securities and Exchange Commission to better understand and respond to this growing crisis.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIGITAL ASSET MARKET CLARITY ACT OF 2025
statements.title: DIGITAL ASSET MARKET CLARITY ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the bipartisan CLARITY Act.
My State, New Jersey, proportionally ranks second nationwide in ownership of cryptocurrency.

While cryptocurrency has tremendous economic potential, we desperately need rules of the road to protect consumers, ensure the success of American entrepreneurs, and ensure that America leads the way, not other nations around the world, but that America leads the way in this growing space.

The CLARITY Act takes commonsense steps to make crypto work for everyday users, including measures to stop snake oil salesmen, fraudsters, and hucksters, and puts the Trump family's coins under regulation.
To do nothing means that we will ensure that Trump's coin has no oversight.
We will ensure that no consumer is protected if we do nothing.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this critical commonsense, bipartisan legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GUIDING AND ESTABLISHING NATIONAL INNOVATION FOR U.S. STABLECOINS ACT
statements.title: GUIDING AND ESTABLISHING NATIONAL INNOVATION FOR U.S. STABLECOINS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the bipartisan GENIUS Act.
The GENIUS Act is smart bipartisan legislation that backs stablecoins through the U.S. dollar on a 1-to-1 basis and allows States to make future safeguards to further protect consumers.
The GENIUS Act, as I said, protects consumers and gives clear rules of the road to allow America to lead the way in a space that is key to our economy.
Now, it is time for us to clarify rules for stablecoins, protect consumers, and promote American innovation.
As I said before, when we were talking about the CLARITY Act, the question is: Do we want some rules of the road or no rules of the road?
To vote against this bill and to vote against the CLARITY Act is irresponsible if you want to make sure that the Trump coin has oversight and that consumers are protected.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MILITARY CONSTRUCTION, VETERANS AFFAIRS, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: MILITARY CONSTRUCTION, VETERANS AFFAIRS, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: My second amendment will help VA hospitals provide kosher meal options for Jewish veterans.

Finally, my third amendment will encourage continued funding for the Staff Sergeant Parker Gordon Fox Suicide Prevention Grant Program, which has delivered millions in grants for mental health services to help prevent veteran suicide.
Mr. Chair, I rise in support of the en bloc package which includes three amendments I offered to the FY 2026 Military Construction, Veterans Affairs, and Related Agencies Appropriations bill.
That is why I strongly urge my colleagues to support the en bloc package.
